remarks: A hip, chic loft in the heart of vibrant downtown SoNo - completely reimagined from top to bottom. This sun-soaked 1bedroom, 2bath residence blends modern sophistication with effortless cool. The open loft layout is framed by refurbished hardwood floors, custom architectural doors, and a just finished renovated kitchen featuring sleek cabinetry, and contemporary finishes. Every detail has been elevated to create a fresh, stylish living experience.  Flooded with natural light throughout the day, this space feels warm, airy, and alive - the perfect backdrop for both quiet mornings and lively evenings. A new HVAC has been installed giving you turnkey comfort and efficiency. Step outside and you are instantly connected to SoNo's restaurants, cafes, waterfront, and energy. A rare, fully redone loft with personality, polish, and sunlight in every corner!
